name: http-endpoints
source: OpenCTI-Platform/opencti@22c7908 (opencti-platform/opencti-graphql/src/http, graphql/sseMiddleware.js and every file that adds a route)
intro: The 34 HTTP endpoints OpenCTI 7.260309.0-lts.8 serves, the GraphQL API included. Paths are relative to the base path (`app:base_path`, empty by default) and use the Express syntax: `:id` is one segment, `*file` the rest of the path. *Token or session* means an `Authorization: Bearer <API token>` header, a Basic login or the cookie of a browser session; a rate limiter applies to every request. Share data through these endpoints as [Feeds, TAXII collections and streams](/opencti/use/share/feeds/) explains; probe the platform as [Health probes](/deploy/operate/health-probes/) explains.

cells: The GraphQL API: queries and mutations, and file uploads as multipart requests. Each operation checks its own capability; a few, such as login, need no authentication.
The GraphQL schema in SDL with the platform version, as JSON (cached one hour).
Starts the login with an SSO provider (OpenID Connect, SAML, OAuth) configured on the platform, by its identifier.
Return address of an SSO provider: opens the session, checks the IP allow list, then redirects to the page the user came from.
Login with a client certificate (HTTPS with client certificate authentication enabled).
Login from the HTTP headers a trusted reverse proxy sets.
Closes the session, logs the logout, and logs out of the SSO provider too when it is set to log out remotely.
An image or file embedded in the content of an entity, by the entity id and the file name.
Downloads a stored file inside a ZIP archive encrypted with the artifact password (`app:artifact_zip_password`).
Downloads a stored file (import, export, attachment) and logs the download.
Renders a stored Markdown file as HTML.
Shows a stored file in the browser (sandboxed) and logs the read.
